mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (user_id, title, content, permission, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{permission}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_like WHERE diary_id = d.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_favorite WHERE diary_id = d.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS favoritedByCurrentUser FROM diary d JOIN sys_user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.permission = 3 ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_like WHERE diary_id = d.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_favorite WHERE diary_id = d.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS favoritedByCurrentUser FROM diary d JOIN sys_user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
